criteria.text: When a Story's test declares an app map in `app_maps` and the interpreter refuses that map during lint, `pdd lint` exits with code 4, reports `refused` with the map's problem code, reason and fix, and reports 0 passing tests for that Story.

When a Story's test declares a refused app map in `app_maps`, `pdd test` exits with code 4, sends 0 check requests and spends 0 AI calls, and `pdd test --read` on that saved lint or check batch preserves `refused` with exit code 4.

When a Story's test declares a refused app map in `app_maps` or `pdd simulate` selects a refused app map, `pdd simulate` sends 0 Try requests and spends 0 AI calls (exit code 4 in page mode, exit code 125 in `--cli` and `--serve` door modes), and an unrelated scoped-out lint refusal prints `Lint diagnostic:` on stderr without throwing.

When the interpreter reports `app_maps` verdicts and a selected app map is `not-checked` or missing its verdict, `pdd lint`, `pdd test` and `pdd simulate` report `not run` with exit code 5 and 0 AI calls; a Story that does not select a refused app map keeps its own passing lint result.

fixture.provenance: Portable synthetic fixture; no operational project material.
fixture.story: user_stories/try-b8.md with one shell step on prompts/shell.prompt.md.
fixture.map: app/maps/b8.json declares screen prompt prompts/screen.prompt.md whose $ref reads /state/attempt/match_code absent from initial_world.
fixture.sibling: user_stories/plain.md and tests/plain.json declare no app_maps.

cases.given: Complete lint returns state: "refused", result.tests: [{path: "tests/try-b8.json", verdict: "passed"}], result.app_maps: [{path: "app/maps/b8.json", verdict: "refused", problems: 1}], result.problems: [{code: "template-reference-unprovable", file: "app/maps/b8.json", at: "initial_world", reason: "...", fix: "...", severity: "error"}], result.refusals: [{code: "lint-refused", path: "app/maps/b8.json", message: "Lint refused this test or app map."}].
cases.expect: pdd lint exits 4; text and --json report lint_state: "refused", rows[0].state: "refused", summary "Lint: 0 of 1 tests pass.", and specific refusal code "template-reference-unprovable" with reason and fix.

cases.given: Another test fails admission first so result.refusals names only tests/broken.json, while result.app_maps marks app/maps/b8.json refused and result.problems carries template-reference-unprovable on app/maps/b8.json.
cases.expect: tests/try-b8.json is still refused with template-reference-unprovable on app/maps/b8.json; generic first-row result.refusals truncation cannot hide the map refusal.

cases.given: Run pdd test, pdd test --read on a standalone lint batch (both pending-then-refused and already-refused), pdd test --retry, and restart recovery when app/maps/b8.json is refused.
cases.expect: Exit 4, 0 /v1/check POSTs, 0 AI calls, and saved --read preserves refused state and specific map refusal.

cases.given: Run pdd simulate in page mode, --cli mode and --serve mode when declared app_maps or selected --app-map is refused; then run pdd simulate on tests/plain.json when an unselected map or test is refused.
cases.expect: Refused map stops before /v1/try POST with 0 AI calls (exit 4 in page mode, exit 125 in door modes); passing tests/plain.json prints Lint diagnostic: on stderr without TypeError and creates the Try.

cases.given: Interpreter returns result.app_maps with app/maps/b8.json verdict "not-checked" or omitted; separately run combined batch [tests/try-b8.json, tests/plain.json] when app/maps/b8.json is refused and tests/plain.json has no map.
cases.expect: Unchecked/unlisted map in a reported app_maps list yields not run (exit 5, 0 check/Try POSTs); legacy answers without app_maps keep passed when no refusal/problem names the map; in the combined batch tests/plain.json passes and dispatches while tests/try-b8.json is refused.

verification_plan.local: Native regression and bounded finite-domain formal tests in test/declared-app-map-lint.test.mjs must fail on baseline c1cdb274 and pass on the fix, plus full public suite via pdd workflow suite --command "npm test".
